place.name: Old Town (Lviv)
place.description: Lviv's Old Town (Ukrainian: Старе Місто Львова, romanized: Stare Misto L'vova; Polish: Stare Miasto we Lwowie) is the historic centre of the city of Lviv, within the Lviv Oblast (province) in Ukraine, recognized as a State Historic-Architectural Reserve in 1975.
